selection.rule: Compare at least three registered candidate prices, level/power and probability settings on exploration seeds; select a Pareto candidate, then evaluate held-out seeds once. Any changed rule invalidates the evidence and requires a new version and run.
selection.highTierUse: Report each tier by immediate/deferred rebirth policy; a tier with zero use by all progression policies rejects the tier schedule.
selection.concentration: Report top template and same-template four-copy rates; no hidden cap or forced diversity.
selection.epics: Report exact independent long-tail non-acquisition estimates and observed held-out zero-acquisition rate; no pity or focused rerolls.
selection.humanFun: Cannot be certified by agent simulation. Record whether human playtesting occurred.

sourceBinding: Hash source, this protocol and candidate before every run; keep failed attempts and require latest valid receipts.
